caption: Performance comparisons of four various prompts of HDM in humour, fluency and coherency, marked by V1, V2, V3 and V4. The y-axis is the score on the GEMBA-SQM.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates a comparison of coherency scores for four distinct prompts, labeled V1, V2, V3, and V4, based on the GEMBA-SQM metric. The horizontal axis displays the prompt labels – V1, V2, V3, and V4 – arranged in left-to-right order. The vertical axis represents the coherency score, ranging from approximately 88 to 98, with a linear scale and tick intervals of 1.0; the axis is labeled “Coherency” and the values are displayed numerically. The tallest bar, representing V2, reaches a value of 93.69, while the shortest bar, representing V1, reaches a value of 92. The orange bar for V1 has a value of 92.8, the blue bar for V2 has a value of 93.69, the green bar for V3 has a value of 91.1, and the purple bar for V4 has a value of 90.1.  All bars are unshaded and appear to be the same height, indicating that no bars are visually emphasized.
